query: Find 10 buildings located in forest areas in Trondheim municipality, sorted by bygningid ascending.

1.description: Get buildings in Trondheim (kommunenummer 5001) with bygningid and representasjonspunkt as GeoJSON

2.description: Inspect distinct AR50 classification columns (arkartstd, artype, arveget, arskogbon) to identify forest codes

3.description: Select AR50 polygons classified as forest (filtered by codes found in step 2) with geometry as GeoJSON

4.description: Find buildings that intersect forest AR50 polygons

5.description: Sort resulting buildings by bygningid ascending
